keyword.description: Target keyword or search phrase (up to 700 chars), e.g. best running shoes

keywords.description: List of seed keywords. DataForSEO Labs Keyword Ideas supports up to 200 keywords. Click to add: seo tools, rank tracker

target.description: Target domain, subdomain, or page without protocol (http/https), e.g. dataforseo.com, example.com

url.description: Direct URL of a search query or page to process, including protocol, e.g. https://example.com

location_code.description: Google Location ID. Common Countries: 2840 (US), 2826 (UK), 2124 (Canada), 2036 (Australia), 2276 (Germany), 2250 (France), 2392 (Japan), 2410 (South Korea), 2356 (India), 2156 (China), 2344 (Hong Kong), 2158 (Taiwan), 2702 (Singapore), 2484 (Mexico), 2076 (Brazil), 2724 (Spain), 2380 (Italy), 2528 (Netherlands), 2756 (Switzerland), 2752 (Sweden), 2040 (Austria), 2764 (Thailand), 2704 (Vietnam), 2458 (Malaysia), 2360 (Indonesia), 2710 (South Africa)

location_name.description: Full search location name, used instead of a location code. Example: United States or London,England,United Kingdom.

location_coordinate.description: GPS location used for localized results. Format is latitude,longitude or latitude,longitude,radius. Example: 40.7128,-74.0060.

language_code.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code. Available: en (English), zh-CN (Simplified Chinese), zh-TW (Traditional Chinese), es (Spanish), de (German), fr (French), ja (Japanese), ko (Korean), pt (Portuguese), it (Italian), nl (Dutch), ru (Russian), ar (Arabic), hi (Hindi), th (Thai), vi (Vietnamese), id (Indonesian), tr (Turkish), pl (Polish), sv (Swedish)

language_name.description: Full search language name, used instead of a language code. Common values: English, Spanish, German, French.

device.description: Device type used to retrieve search results. Common values: desktop, mobile. Default is desktop.

os.description: Operating system used for the selected device. Desktop values: windows, macos; mobile values: android, ios.

se_domain.description: Search engine domain used for the request, such as google.com, google.co.uk, or google.com.au. If omitted, the domain is selected automatically.

search_engine.description: Search engine used for keyword or SERP data. Values: google, bing, yahoo, yandex, baidu, naver.

search_engine_type.description: Search engine result type or vertical. Common values: organic, news, images, videos, shopping, maps.

depth.description: Number of SERP results to parse. Default is 10; maximum is 200 (or 100 depending on endpoint). Greater depth can increase cost.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Common values are 10, 100, and 1000; the maximum depends on the endpoint.

offset.description: Number of records to skip before returning results. Use 0 for the first page and increase it (e.g., 100) for pagination.

sort_by.description: Field used to sort returned records. Common values include relevance, search_volume, cpc, competition, keyword_difficulty, and etv.

order_by.description: Sorting rules in field and direction format. Use up to three rules, such as relevance,desc, search_volume,desc, or etv,desc.

filters.description: Filtering conditions as a JSON nested array (up to 8 filters). Operators: >, >=, =, <>, in, like, not_like. Click to apply: [["keyword_info.search_volume", ">", 100]]

item_types.description: SERP result types to include in the response. Common values: organic, paid, featured_snippet, local_pack.

include_serp_info.description: Includes SERP metrics and SERP item types for each keyword. Use true to include SERP information or false to omit it.

include_subdomains.description: Controls whether subdomains are included in domain-level analysis. Use true to include subdomains or false to analyze only the main domain.

include_clickstream_data.description: Includes clickstream-based traffic and demographic metrics. Use true to enable it (may increase cost) or false to omit it.

closely_variants.description: Controls keyword matching. true searches close phrase variants; false uses broader matching.

ignore_synonyms.description: Excludes highly similar or synonymous keywords when enabled. Use true to return only core keywords or false to include them.

historical_serp_mode.description: Historical SERP collection mode. Values: live for currently ranking results, lost for lost results, or all for both.

backlinks_status_type.description: Backlink status category to analyze. Common values: live for currently active links, lost for lost links, and all for both.

mode.description: Processing mode for endpoints that support multiple analysis modes. Common values include as_is, one_per_domain, subdomains, and pages.

tag.description: User-defined task identifier used to associate requests and results (max 255 chars). Example: project_batch_1.

calculate_rectangles.description: Returns pixel coordinates and dimensions for SERP elements (may incur extra charge). Use true to calculate or false to omit.

load_resources.description: Controls whether page resources (images, stylesheets, scripts) are loaded during crawling. Use true to load or false to skip.

enable_javascript.description: Enables JavaScript rendering during crawling. Use true for JS-dependent pages or false for faster non-rendered crawling.

enable_browser_rendering.description: Enables browser-based rendering for pages requiring a real browser environment. Use true to render or false for standard crawling.

browser_screen_width.description: Browser viewport width in pixels (range 240–9999). Common values: 1366, 1440, 1920.

browser_screen_height.description: Browser viewport height in pixels (range 240–9999). Common values: 768, 900, 1080.

max_crawl_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (max 100). Common values: 1, 10, 100.

search_param.description: Additional search-engine query parameters appended to the search request. Example: safe=active.

group_organic_results.description: Controls how related organic results are represented. Use true to group related results under their parent or false to separate them.

resolve_goto_urls.description: Resolves search-engine redirect URLs to final destination URLs. Use true to resolve or false to keep original URLs.

resolve_poisoned_results.description: Detects and resolves potentially poisoned SERP results. Use true to enable detection or false to disable.

load_async_ai_overview.description: Loads asynchronous AI Overview elements when available. Use true to request or false to omit.

target_search_mode.description: Controls how target matching is evaluated. Use any when one target match is sufficient or all when every target must match.

match_type.description: Target matching rule used with crawl stopping or target detection. Values: domain, with_subdomains, wildcard.

match_value.description: Domain, subdomain, URL path, or wildcard pattern used for matching. Examples: example.com, example.com/, /blog/.

stop_crawl_on_match.description: Targets that stop crawling when matched, as a JSON array of objects (up to 10 targets). Click to apply: [{"match_type":"domain","match_value":"example.com"}]

find_targets_in.description: SERP element types in which target matches are searched. Common values: organic, paid, local_pack, featured_snippet.

ignore_targets_in.description: SERP element types excluded from target matching. Common values: organic, paid, local_pack, images.

remove_from_url.description: URL parameters removed from URLs returned in SERP results. Common values: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign.

include_ranked_keywords.description: Includes ranked keyword data in domain or page analysis. Use true to include or false to omit.

include_lost_serp.description: Includes keywords or SERP elements that are no longer ranking. Use true to include lost results or false for current results only.

include_history.description: Includes historical metrics where supported. Use true to request historical data or false for latest snapshot only.

exclude_top_domains.description: Domains excluded from keyword or competitor results (without protocol). Common values: wikipedia.org, youtube.com.

category_code.description: Numeric category identifier used to restrict keyword or marketplace data to a category. Default is 0.

date_from.description: Start date for historical data in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2025-01-01.

date_to.description: End date for historical data in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2025-12-31.

include_content_info.description: Includes content-level information in supported OnPage results. Use true to include or false to omit.

check_spell.description: Requests spelling and autocorrection information for supported SERP endpoints. Use true to include or false to omit.

store_raw_html.description: Stores or returns the raw HTML document when supported. Use true to retain or false to skip.

custom_js.description: Custom JavaScript executed during page rendering (requires enable_javascript=true).

custom_js_timeout.description: Maximum execution time for custom JavaScript in milliseconds. Common values: 1000, 5000, 10000.

respect_sitemap.description: Controls whether sitemap files are used to discover URLs during crawling. Use true to respect or false to ignore.

check_robots_txt.description: Controls whether the crawler checks robots.txt directives. Use true to follow rules or false to ignore.

crawl_depth.description: Maximum link depth from the starting URL. Common values: 1, 2, 5.

max_crawl_urls.description: Maximum number of URLs processed during an OnPage crawl. Common values: 100, 1000, 10000.

custom_user_agent.description: Custom user-agent string sent during crawling. Common value: Mozilla/5.0.

return_charts.description: Returns chart or historical visualization data when supported. Use true to include charts or false to omit.

bid.description: Maximum bid value used for paid search data. Values: a positive numeric bid amount in the supported currency.

browser_preset.description: Browser screen preset used when rendering a page. Values: desktop, mobile, tablet.

categories.description: Target business or technology category identifiers used to filter listings. Example: ["Restaurant"] or ["payment_processors"].

exclude_internal_backlinks.description: Excludes backlinks between pages on the same domain from backlink results.

keyword_fields.description: Page fields searched for keyword citations. Common values: title, main_title, previous_title, snippet.

load_rank_absolute.description: Returns ranking distribution based on the absolute SERP position across all result elements.

markdown_view.description: Returns parsed page content in Markdown format in the page_as_markdown field.

match.description: Specifies how a keyword or search term should match the target data. Values: exact, phrase, broad.

page_type.description: Types of web pages to include in content analysis. Common values: ecommerce, news, blogs, message-boards.

rank_scale.description: Defines the scale used to calculate or represent ranking values. Values: one_hundred (0–100), one_thousand (0–1000).

se_type.description: Specifies the search engine type used for retrieving search data. Common values: google, bing, yahoo, youtube, amazon.

search_mode.description: Specifies the search matching mode used to find results. Values: as_is, one_per_domain.

technology.description: Name of a specific technology used to filter results. Common values: WordPress, Nginx, Salesforce.

technology_category.description: Identifier of the technology category used to filter technology data. Common values: cms, crm, web_servers, payment_processors.

technology_group.description: Identifier of the technology group used to filter technology data. Common values: content, marketing, sales, web_development.

type.description: Specifies the type of data source, result, or request being processed. Common values: web, news, youtube, images, froogle.
